detail_panel_spec:
  version: 0.1
  intent: "Declarative, extensible control of detail-panel behavior, rendering, and mutations."

  primitives:
    id: "stable globally unique string"
    path: "address into domain graph (dot/jsonpath/ref)"
    expr: "pure evaluable expression over context"
    event: "typed intent payload"
    patch: "minimal domain mutation"
    capability: "named permission flag"

  context:
    scope:
      app: ["kit","design","type","quality","home","*"]
      subject: {kind: "entity_kind", id: "id"}
      selection: [{kind: "entity_kind", id: "id"}]
    state:
      ui: {}
      domain_snapshot: {}
      presence: {}
      runtime: {locale: "string", device: "string", mode: "string"}

  section_registry:
    source: "dynamic providers + static declarations"
    section:
      id: "id"
      zone: ["details"]
      order: "number"
      priority: "number"
      sticky: "bool"
      when: "expr"
      title: {i18n: "key", fallback: "string"}
      open:
        default: "bool"
        policy: ["manual","remember","auto"]
      content: ["node_ref"]
      actions: ["action_ref"]

  node_model:
    node:
      id: "id"
      kind: ["group","field","list","matrix","action","custom"]
      when: "expr"
      layout: {span: "int", density: "token", variant: "token"}
      children: ["node_ref"]

  field_model:
    field:
      id: "id"
      label: {i18n: "key", fallback: "string"}
      control: ["text","textarea","number","stepper","slider","toggle","select","combobox","color","date","json","custom"]
      bind:
        read: {from: "path|expr", empty: "value"}
        write:
          to: "path|command"
          transform_in: "expr?"
          transform_out: "expr?"
          strategy: ["immediate","lazy","debounced","transaction"]
      validate:
        rules: [{id: "id", when: "expr", assert: "expr", level: ["error","warn","info"], message_i18n: "key"}]
      visibility: "expr"
      enabled: "expr"
      mixed:
        mode: ["detect","force","off"]
        token: "string"

  action_model:
    action:
      id: "id"
      label: {i18n: "key", fallback: "string"}
      icon: "token?"
      when: "expr"
      enabled: "expr"
      run:
        emit: "event?"
        command: "string?"
        patch: "patch?"
        transaction: ["none","start_finalize","external"]

  selection_resolution:
    policy:
      kinds: ["single_kind","multi_kind","cross_kind"]
      resolver: "expr"
      fallbacks: ["known_ids","name_match","reference_match"]
      conflicts: ["prefer_specific","prefer_recent","error"]

  mutation_pipeline:
    stages:
      - "intent"
      - "authorize(capability)"
      - "validate"
      - "normalize"
      - "diff/patch"
      - "apply"
      - "publish(events)"
      - "undo_checkpoint"
    guarantees:
      atomic: true
      idempotent: "best_effort"
      reversible: true
      auditable: true

  extensibility:
    plugins:
      register:
        sections: true
        nodes: true
        controls: true
        validators: true
        serializers: true
      collision_policy: ["namespace","override_by_priority","reject"]
    compatibility:
      schema_evolution: ["additive","feature_flags","adapter_hooks"]

  interoperability:
    data_sources:
      read: ["snapshot","selector","computed"]
      write: ["command_bus","store_patch","domain_api"]
    sync:
      modes: ["local","collaborative","offline_first"]
      conflict_resolution: ["last_writer","merge_strategy","custom_resolver"]

  non_functional:
    performance:
      incremental_render: true
      memoized_selectors: true
      bounded_recompute: true
    accessibility:
      keyboard_complete: true
      screen_reader_labels: true
      focus_contract: true
    observability:
      trace_ids: true
      metrics: ["render_ms","apply_ms","validation_failures"]
      logs: ["intent","mutation","error"]

  security:
    policy:
      field_level_capabilities: true
      sanitize_input: true
      safe_expression_runtime: true
      redact_sensitive_fields: true

  testing_contract:
    invariants:
      - "same input context -> same visible tree"
      - "disabled fields never mutate"
      - "failed validation blocks apply"
      - "undo restores exact prior snapshot"
      - "section ordering deterministic"

  minimal_example:
    section:
      id: "design.properties"
      zone: "details"
      order: 50
      when: "scope.app == 'design'"
      content:
        - id: "design.name"
          kind: "field"
          label: {i18n: "design.name"}
          control: "text"
          bind:
            read: {from: "domain_snapshot.design.name"}
            write: {to: "command:updateDesign.name", strategy: "lazy"}
